fbxAlternateExportPolicy.reason: The FBX walking files are alternate exports of the same named walking takes already present in compatible GLB form. Their Blender-normalized bind matrices differ by container coordinate conversion, so duplicating them would add no unique motion and would require unnecessary axis retargeting.

rejectedProceduralCharacterPolicy.reason: The meshes were rejected by the user, and the 95/97-bone rigs have different bind axes, proportions, control hierarchies, and deformation assumptions from the locked 24-bone Meshy skins.
rejectedProceduralCharacterPolicy.preservation: quarantined as historical project-authored reference assets only

projectAuthoredLockedRigPolicy.method: additive local-space animation over the loaded locked rig's own bind transforms
